name: Day1
where: Pause list in the tray menu and under Pause in the settings window, after 2 hours

name: DaysCount
where: A pause length of whole days, as the Pause for window says it after a number out of range; {0} is a number
why: whole days are counted by V1Words.Days, since Arabic says two days and eleven days in forms of their own

name: PauseForTitle
where: Title of the small window that Custom… in the pause list opens, and the screen reader name of its number box

name: PauseForUnit
where: Screen reader name of the list beside the number in the Pause for window

name: UnitMinutes
where: Pause for window, the unit list

name: UnitHours
where: Pause for window, the unit list

name: UnitDays
where: Pause for window, the unit list

name: PauseForRange
where: Pause for window, the line under the number while it is in range

name: PauseForClamped
en: Only 1 minute to 7 days work, so it pauses for {0}.
ar: اكتب مدة من دقيقة واحدة إلى 7 أيام. القيمة المستخدمة الآن: {0}.
where: Pause for window, the line under the number after one out of range; {0} is the nearest length, such as 7 days

name: PauseForNotANumber
where: Pause for window, the line under the number while the box holds no number; Pause is off until it does

name: PausedUntilTomorrow
where: Status box at the top and tray icon tooltip, when the pause ends tomorrow; {0} is the time of day, as in PausedUntil

name: PausedUntilDay
where: Status box at the top and tray icon tooltip, when the pause ends later than tomorrow; {0} is the day of the week (Saturday), or the date a full week on; {1} is the time of day
